title.zh: 进一步延长某些住宅单元的租金管制期，为此修订Batas Pambansa Blg. 877（即《规定某些住宅单元租金稳定与管制并为其他目的》，经修正）的法案
title.en: An Act Further Extending the Rent Control Period for Certain Residential Units Amending Thereby Batas Pambansa Blg. 877 Entitled: "An Act Providing for the Stabilization and Regulation of Rentals of Certain Residential Units, and for Other Purposes, as Amended
title.orig: An Act Further Extending the Rent Control Period for Certain Residential Units Amending Thereby Batas Pambansa Blg. 877 Entitled: "An Act Providing for the Stabilization and Regulation of Rentals of Certain Residential Units, and for Other Purposes, as Amended

text.en:
Beginning January 1, 1998 and for a duration of four (4) years thereafter ending on December 31, 2001, monthly rentals of all residential units covered by Batas Pambansa Blg. 877, shall not be increased by the lessor by more than the rates herein provided for:
PERIOD
MAXIMUM INCREASE
January 1, 1998 - December 31, 1998 Fifteen percent (15%) January 1, 1999 - December 31, 1999 Fifteen percent (15%) January 1, 2000 - December 31, 2000 Fifteen percent (15%) January 1, 2001 - December 31, 2001 Fifteen percent (15%) Provided, That the basis for the maximum increase herein authorized for the four-year period shall be the actual monthly rental as of December 31, 1997: Provided, further, That the increase authorized herein shall be cumulative and compounded.
This Act shall take effect on January 1, 1998, following its publication in at least two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
